roi.title: How we calculate
roi.intro: These are cautious assumptions, not measurements. You can change the numbers below.
roi.stepTime: Front desk: × {{min}} min of confirming, reminding and rebooking by Zalo/phone = ~{{h}} hours
roi.stepNoShow: {{rate}} no-shows × {{cut}} fewer with automatic reminders = ~{{a}} bookings kept
roi.source: The {{cut}} cut is below what healthcare reminder studies report (BMJ Open 2016; Hasvold & Wootton 2011: about 34%). Fewer double bookings are not counted. This is not money GuGu pays your salon.
roi.stepOwner: Owner: {{staff}} staff × ({{comm}} min commissions + {{pay}} min payroll) + {{tally}} min monthly profit tally = ~{{h}} hours
roi.stepOwnerSolo: Owner: {{tally}} min monthly profit tally (no staff payroll) = ~{{h}} hours
roi.sourceOwner: Times are cautious assumptions: about 1 hour per staff member a month for commissions (collecting completed services, applying rates, checking), 20 min per staff member to assemble payroll, 1 hour a month to add up profit in a notebook or Excel; with several locations, staff count across all of them. Hours are not converted into money.
roi.upliftNote: Includes {{pct}} more bookings: salons that want the AI assistant usually have more clients (assumption). You can change it; your number applies to every plan.
roi.stepAssistant: Gu assistant: + {{min}} min of owner questions answered by Gu instead of digging through reports (assumption, grows with team size)
roi.stepCalls: Shared calendar and client list (Ultra): + {{locs}} locations × {{min}} min a week of fewer calls between branches (assumption)
roi.stepReports: Combined reports (Ultra): + {{locs}} locations × {{min}} min a month merging each location's notebook/Excel (assumption)
roi.stepTotals: = ~{{desk}} front-desk hours + ~{{owner}} owner hours a month
